name: Palantir
description: Palantir sells data-integration and AI software platforms to governments and large companies: Gotham (defense and intelligence), Foundry (business data operations), Apollo (software deployment) and AIP (its generative AI platform). It reports two segments, government (51.8% of first-half 2026 revenue) and commercial (48.2%), and a single operating profit. Revenue is mostly software subscriptions and multi-year contracts. Growth has accelerated sharply: revenue +93% in Q2 2026, US commercial +149%. Customers number 1,049; the top 20 average $124M of trailing revenue each and the top three customers were 16% of 2025 revenue. It has a three-class share structure that concentrates voting with founders Stephen Cohen, Alexander Karp and Peter Thiel.

businessLines.name: Government
businessLines.how: Multi-year contracts with government agencies, paid for software licences, deployment work and, increasingly, AI platform use; contracts can be large and lumpy, and US government revenue was $809M in Q2 2026 (+90%).
businessLines.description: Gotham and Foundry for defense, intelligence and civilian agencies, US and allied.

businessLines.name: Commercial
businessLines.how: Subscription and usage contracts with large companies; US commercial revenue $764M in Q2 2026 (+149%), 653 US commercial customers (+35%).
businessLines.description: Foundry and AIP for large companies in energy, manufacturing, health, finance and others.
